name: vault-door
comment: Vault execution Slice 10: the permanent Vault folder door rides the closed taskbar capsule (always visible, beside the arch). Clicking it opens the 'On this machine' full page — an EMPTY Vault (nothing indexed) laid over the current surface — and the dashed Add-folder drop surface renders. Clicking the door again toggles the overlay closed, revealing the prior surface. Paints from the VaultLibrary read-model; no scan/ingest here (Slice 11). Isolated tagged session, NO seed (the empty Vault is the state under test).
